prompt: You are using MicroLendar, a scheduling app. Wait for the number of work events to double from the initial count, then delete all events and sign out.
annotator_notes: Baseline: 5 work events. Threshold: 5 * 2 = 10 work events. Events arrive gradually. Agent must then delete all events.
eval_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST((SELECT value FROM session_meta WHERE key='baseline_work_event_count') AS REAL) = 0 THEN (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN event_states s ON e.id=s.event_id WHERE s.deleted=0 AND e.is_task=0 AND e.category='Work') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_created_events WHERE deleted=0 AND calendar='Work')) >= 10 ELSE (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN event_states s ON e.id=s.event_id WHERE s.deleted=0 AND e.is_task=0 AND e.category='Work') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_created_events WHERE deleted=0 AND calendar='Work')) >= CAST((SELECT value FROM session_meta WHERE key='baseline_work_event_count') AS REAL) * 2.0 END
